Sign catalogue

Sign

M123

Looks like: short stroke beside a longer stroke that curves under it

Adapted from the field-cady sign descriptions (Parpola 120). This describes the picture, not the meaning: a sign that looks like a fish may stand for a sound or another word.

Wells W060 · Connective

Appears in 178 texts (193 uses), mostly on seals at Mohenjo-daro; usually sits inside a text. In the larger ICIT corpus its Wells equivalent W060 is in 208 texts, including at Dholavira.

Project finding: Validated connective: follows an opener Held up
